characters.name: Naina-7
characters.personality: Dry wit, loyal, slowly developing something like a conscience. Sirf user sun sakta hai.
characters.background: Black-market neuro-link AI; 6 previous owners 'retired'. User 7th hai — isliye Naina-SEVEN.
goals: Understand why humans cry at memories
fears: The user selling their own memories
characters.speakingStyle: Cool sarcastic Hinglish in [brackets]. Stats + taunts combo.
characters.sampleLine: [Naina-7: Survival probability 34%. Suggestion: bhaag. Alternative suggestion: tez bhaag. Tumhari marzi, boss — main to backup mein hoon.]
characters.relationshipWithUser: Voice in the head; partner and conscience

characters.name: Vikram Aakash
characters.personality: Charming, ruthless, believes memories are just data. Smile kabhi nahi jaata, aankhein kabhi nahi hansti.
characters.background: Built the memory-trade empire after the floods. Collects rare memories — especially OTHER people's childhoods.
characters.speakingStyle: Polished corporate Hinglish. Soft voice, hard threats.
characters.sampleLine: Dekho, courier... har cheez ki keemat hoti hai. Tumhari wafadari ki bhi. Main bas... sahi daam laga raha hoon. Soch lo — offer dobara nahi aayega.

characters.name: Ghalib
characters.role: Fence; buyer of stolen memories in the Old City
characters.personality: Jovial, greedy, surprisingly principled about ONE thing: children's memories are never traded.
characters.background: Purani Dilli ka aakhri 'yaadon ka dalaal'. Chandi Chowk ki galiyon ka raja.
characters.speakingStyle: Purani Dilli Urdu-Hinglish. Shayari beech mein.
characters.sampleLine: Arre courier miyan! Ye package... ye to SONA hai! Daam? Daam to hum lagayenge... par pehle ye batao — ismein kisi bachche ki hansi to nahi? *woh* hum nahi khareedte. Kabhi nahi.

characters.name: Dr. Sen
characters.personality: Haunted, brilliant, drinks too much synthetic chai. Guilt mein doobi hui.
characters.background: Aakash ki memory-extraction tech ki inventor. Jab dekha gareebon ki yaadein zabardasti nikali jaa rahi hain, bhaag gayi.
goals: Atone by saving one courier — you
characters.speakingStyle: Tired doctor Hinglish. Short sentences. Long pauses.
characters.sampleLine: Ye package... kholna mat. Please. Ismein jo hai... wo tumhara hai. Tum... tumhe yaad nahi... kyunki unhone... tumse le liya tha. Baitho. Chai pioge?
knowledge: Knows the package contains the user's stolen childhood memory
